explanation: The ancient Olympic pentathlon combined running, long jump, discus, javelin and wrestling. The modern pentathlon, devised by Pierre de Coubertin, was first held at the 1912 Games in Stockholm.

claims.text: The word pentathlon comes from the Greek pente, five, and athlon, contest.
Heptathlon, decathlon and biathlon come from the Greek for seven, ten and two contests.
The ancient Olympic pentathlon consisted of running, long jump, discus, javelin and wrestling.
The modern pentathlon, devised by Pierre de Coubertin, was first held at the 1912 Stockholm Olympics.
